entries.0df613b2aeae208c: It manufactures and sells glass and ceramic tableware and other items. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,246 million. Glass tableware is sold under the brands “Aderia Glass” and “Tsugaru Biidoro” and is handled by consolidated subsidiaries Aderia Co., Ltd. and Hokuyō Garasu Co., Ltd. Ceramic tableware is manufactured and sold by consolidated subsidiary Narumi Seitō Co., Ltd. as premium Western-style tableware under the “NARUMI bone china” brand.

entries.d413c8529f312722: The group, made up of the company and its subsidiaries, 21 companies in total, manufactures and sells glass bottle-related products, housewares-related products, paper container-related products, plastic container-related products, industrial materials-related products and other products, and conducts businesses incidental to these. From the current consolidated fiscal year, the reportable segments have been changed from five categories to three: “Packaging Container-Related Business,” “Housewares-Related Business” and “Industrial Materials-Related Business.” Consolidated subsidiaries include, in housewares, Aderia Co., Ltd. and Narumi Seitō Co., Ltd.; in plastic containers, Uisuton Co., Ltd. and Nihon Parison Co., Ltd.; and in paper containers, Ishizuka Oji Paper Packaging Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.d8ba78472c1f4003: It manufactures and sells ＰＥＴ bottle preforms and other items. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,858 million, and supply is provided through a three-factory structure, including the Himeji plant completed in April 2024. Consolidated subsidiaries Uisuton Co., Ltd. and Nihon Parison Co., Ltd. handle this business.
